title: Refined Topology-Pass Scheduling: Damped Trust-Region Compensation for Dynamic k-NN Graphs in SE(3)-Equivariant Structure Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equivariant structure-prediction pipelines alternate coordinate updates with the construction of a k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) graph whose membership is a discrete, piecewise-constant function of the coordinates. Rebuilding that graph at every block boundary (PB) is the expensive part of an epoch, whereas reusing one frozen graph (F) is fast but leaves a topology gap. We study a two-pass design in which the cheap pass records a small amount of state (margins, kNN radii, measured per-boundary displacements) and a second pass compensates conservatively. translated_title: 精细化拓扑遍次调度：SE(3)等变结构预测中动态k近邻图的阻尼信赖域补偿
translated_abstract: 等变结构预测流水线在坐标更新与k近邻（kNN）图构建之间交替进行，其中图的成员关系是坐标的离散、分段常数函数。在每个块边界（PB）重建该图是训练轮次中最昂贵的部分，而复用一个冻结图（F）虽然快速，却会留下拓扑差距。我们研究了一种双遍设计：廉价的遍次记录少量状态信息（间隔边距、kNN半径、实测的每边界位移），第二遍则进行保守补偿。我们将图构建基准的选择形式化为一个阻尼不动点迭代，其唯一不动点恰好为PB，并由此推导出：(i) 具有双侧常数 $m_i/4$ 和单侧常数 $m_i/2$ 的精确不翻转（non-flip）证书；(ii) 最小方差（BLUE）重放增益 $\gamma^*$ 及由此产生的可行性交叉点；(iii) 一个 $\ell_\infty$ 信赖域投影，可保……
tldr: 提出一种双遍拓扑调度方案，将动态kNN图构建基准的选择形式化为以逐块重建（PB）为唯一不动点的阻尼不动点迭代，并借助不翻转证书、最小方差（BLUE）重放增益与ℓ∞信赖域投影进行保守补偿，从而在SE(3)等变结构预测中以低成本逼近逐块重建的拓扑精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a two-pass topology scheduling scheme that formulates dynamic kNN graph basis selection as a damped fixed-point iteration whose unique fixed point is the per-block rebuild, using exact non-flip certificates, a minimum-variance (BLUE) replay gain, and an ℓ∞ trust-region projection to conservatively approximate per-block topology at low cost in SE(3)-equivariant structure prediction.
